snippet.title: Shine in Shadows | Official Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
The night came and did not end. Carry the last lantern and burn back the dark.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5505560/Shine_in_Shadows/
Website: https://shineinshadows.com/

Shine in Shadows is a dark pixel-art roguelite. Your lantern is your weapon: point it at the shadows and they burn. The light runs on oil, so keep moving and pick up flasks to keep it lit.

- Aim your light by hand, or let your abilities fight on their own
- Build your run from cards and evolutions
- Fire or Frost: choose what your wand becomes
- Five acts of a night that did not end
- Play alone or with a friend in online co-op

Coming soon to Steam for Windows.

Follow the game:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shineinshadowsgame/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@shineinshadowsgame

Made by Bunito Games: https://bunito.games/

#ShineInShadows #roguelite #indiegame
